title: BARK COMMANDER // REFUSING TO LEAVE THE DOG
narrative: Melisandre chants by the funeral pyre: 'Arise, Jon Snow! Take up your sword!' Inside Ghost's albino direwolf body, Jon Snow yawns, stretches four furry legs, and rolls onto his back for a belly rub. 'Return to a freezing corpse with stab wounds and five hundred letters from Karstarks about winter rations? Absolutely not. Here I get raw venison, zero Night's Watch administrative committees, and nobody stabs me for treason.' He lets out a content woof and falls asleep.
resolvesPlotHole: Jon Snow Prefers Being Ghost Over Doing Paperwork
